name: eja-workflow
description: Task methodology for Kimi Work: Superpowers, Spec Kit, Serena and independent review.
author: Eja
skillInstructions: Применяй этот скилл в Kimi Work с фактически доступными инструментами. Точные правила пользователя и согласованный объём выше общих рекомендаций. Не загружай стартовый скилл рекурсивно.

interface.shortDescription: From agreed requirements to implementation and independent review.
interface.longDescription: A Kimi Work desktop plugin connecting Superpowers, Spec Kit, their bridge and Serena. Includes an entry skill, phase checkpoints, a child-agent profile and a bounded internal auditor. Dependencies are separate. Ordinary replies focus on task results; no service text is inserted into user messages. Automatic methodology compliance is not guaranteed. Tested on Windows.
tryPrompts: Discuss an idea and clarify requirements before coding
Continue the active feature using its tasks.md

eja-workflow.description: MANDATORY first tool call for work tasks, before file inspection, commands, fixes, brainstorming, planning or tests. Small and previously approved tasks are included.

workflow-checkpoint.description: MANDATORY at brainstorming and planning entry, before writing code or tests, and after independent review.
